choice.basis: The chart shows a clear positive association across five selected high-burden asthma regions: as the PM2.5 exposure index increases from ~30 (Region A) to ~70 (Region E), Asthma ER visits rise from ~62 to ~160. This is a selected-regional dashboard comparison, not a population-wide dataset, so it supports escalation for broader review rather than an immediate enterprise-wide claim.
choice.option_label: Escalate this selected-region pattern for broader population review before advancing an enterprise-wide claim
